Interface CallableProcessingInterceptor

All Known Implementing Classes:
TimeoutCallableProcessingInterceptor
public interface CallableProcessingInterceptor
Intercepts concurrent request handling, where the concurrent result is obtained by executing a Callable on behalf of the application with an AsyncTaskExecutor.

CallableProcessingInterceptor 会在异步线程中调用 Callable 任务之前和之后被触发，也会在容器线程因超时而报错时，或因任何原因（包括超时而网络错误）完成之后被触发。

作为一般规则，拦截器方法抛出的异常将导致异步处理通过返回容器并使用该异常实例作为并发结果来恢复。随后，这些异常将通过 `HandlerExceptionResolver`》机制进行处理。

``handleTimeout` 方法可以选择一个值用于恢复处理。

Since:
3.2
Author:
Rossen Stoyanchev，Rob Winch

  • Method Details

    • beforeConcurrentHandling

      default <T> void beforeConcurrentHandling(NativeWebRequest request, Callable<T> task) throws Exception
      Invoked before the start of concurrent handling in the original thread in which the Callable is submitted for concurrent handling.

      这对于在调用 Callable 之前捕获当前线程的状态非常有用。一旦捕获了状态，就可以将其转移到新的 Thread 中，在 preProcess(NativeWebRequest, Callable) 方法中完成。捕获 Spring Security 的 SecurityContextHolder 状态并将其迁移到新线程是此功能的一个具体应用示例。

      默认实现为空。

      Parameters:
      request - 当前请求
      task - 当前异步请求的任务
      Throws:
      Exception - 在发生错误时

    • preProcess

      default <T> void preProcess(NativeWebRequest request, Callable<T> task) throws Exception
      Invoked after the start of concurrent handling in the async thread in which the Callable is executed and before the actual invocation of the Callable.

      默认实现为空。

      Parameters:
      request - 当前请求
      task - 当前异步请求的任务
      Throws:
      Exception - 在发生错误时

    • postProcess

      default <T> void postProcess(NativeWebRequest request, Callable<T> task, @Nullable Object concurrentResult) throws Exception
      Invoked after the Callable has produced a result in the async thread in which the Callable is executed. This method may be invoked later than afterTimeout or afterCompletion depending on when the Callable finishes processing.

      默认实现为空。

      Parameters:
      request - 当前请求
      task - 当前异步请求的任务
      concurrentResult - 并发处理的结果，如果 Callable 抛出异常，则可能是一个 Throwable
      Throws:
      Exception - 在发生错误时

    • handleTimeout

      default <T> Object handleTimeout(NativeWebRequest request, Callable<T> task) throws Exception
      Invoked from a container thread when the async request times out before the Callable task completes. Implementations may return a value, including an Exception, to use instead of the value the Callable did not return in time.

      默认实现始终返回RESULT_NONE。

      Parameters:
      request - 当前请求
      task - 当前异步请求的任务
      Returns:
      一个并发结果值；如果该值不是RESULT_NONE或RESPONSE_HANDLED，则恢复并发处理，且不会调用后续的拦截器。
      Throws:
      Exception - 在发生错误时

    • handleError

      default <T> Object handleError(NativeWebRequest request, Callable<T> task, Throwable t) throws Exception
      Invoked from a container thread when an error occurred while processing the async request before the Callable task completes. Implementations may return a value, including an Exception, to use instead of the value the Callable did not return in time.

      默认实现始终返回RESULT_NONE。

      Parameters:
      request - 当前请求
      task - 当前异步请求的任务
      t - 请求处理过程中发生的错误
      Returns:
      一个并发结果值；如果该值不是RESULT_NONE或RESPONSE_HANDLED，则恢复并发处理，且不会调用后续的拦截器。
      Throws:
      Exception - 在发生错误时
      Since:
      5.0

    • afterCompletion

      default <T> void afterCompletion(NativeWebRequest request, Callable<T> task) throws Exception
      Invoked from a container thread when async processing completes for any reason including timeout or network error.

      默认实现为空。

      Parameters:
      request - 当前请求
      task - 当前异步请求的任务
      Throws:
      Exception - 在发生错误时
